checkedAlternates.risk: Both DNA and RNA polymerases synthesize nucleic acids.
checkedAlternates.resolution: DNA polymerase catalyzes DNA replication (group-1), whereas RNA polymerase catalyzes transcription (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: AUG is made of three nucleobases.
checkedAlternates.resolution: AUG is the three-base mRNA start codon read during translation (group-3), not an individual DNA base (group-4).
